logo.purpose: The squish wordmark with its mint dot.

title.purpose: Drop zone title and dialog section heads (700 there).

body-strong.purpose: File names, medium buttons, row saving (700).

label.purpose: Chips, segments, small buttons, settings notes.

caption.purpose: Field captions, status pills, file detail lines, language switch.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Every glass panel, the kind tabs and the dock; paired with backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.4).

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Info dialog only, over a backdrop of rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5) with blur(6px).

shadows.name: knob

motion.name: ease-out-soft

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.value: opacity 260ms, transform translateY(24px) scale(0.97) to none over 360ms
motion.purpose: Info dialog rise-and-fade, with backdrop blur fading in over 260ms.

motion.name: dock-pop
motion.purpose: Saving figure lift when it changes; the figure also counts up.

motion.name: working-slide
motion.purpose: Mint band sliding along a progress bar with unknown progress.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Radio group drawn as a glass track; the chosen segment is a light pill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); width: 320px; } .ds-seg-item { flex: 1; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #a3abc0); font-family: 'Sora Variable', 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--foreground, #eef1f8); } .ds-seg-item.is-on { background: var(--foreground, #eef1f8); color: var(--background, #0b0f15); } .ds-seg-item.is-off { opacity: 0.4; text-decoration: line-through; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #8fd3c4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-range { appearance: none; width: 260px; height: 28px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary, #8fd3c4) var(--fill), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) var(--fill)); } .ds-range::-moz-range-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary, #8fd3c4) var(--fill), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) var(--fill)); } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--foreground, #eef1f8); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--foreground, #eef1f8); } .ds-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: scale(1.15); } .ds-range:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #8fd3c4); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A calm night sky with a tool in it. The ground is near-black, a muted aurora hangs behind everything, and every working surface is one material: frosted glass that lets the aurora glow through. Colour is spent sparingly so the only things that stand out are the files and the saving. The user asked for nothing that hurts the eyes; that request is a system invariant, not a mood.

Density is moderate and single-column: one centred column of glass panels, each doing one job, with a glass dock pinned to the bottom of the window when there are results. Type is one family throughout, heavy and tightly tracked at display sizes, medium weight for reading. Motion is soft and short: rise-and-fade for the dialog, a small lift when the saving figure changes, a count-up on the figure itself.

The world refuses both the white-box-with-indigo default and loud neon dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with a heavily blurred, low-opacity aurora fixed behind the page.
Frosted glass is the only surface material; panels, tabs, dock and dialog all share it.
One accent (polar mint) for the primary action, progress and saving; amber and rose only carry status.
Selection is a light pill (starlight on night), never an accent fill.
Pills and rounded rectangles only; the edge-pinned dock is the one square-cornered surface.
Sora for everything, Onest filling the glyphs Sora lacks.

rules.name: The One Mint Rule
rules.body: Polar mint is the only accent. It marks the primary action, progress and saving; nothing else gets a hue.

rules.name: The Outlined Status Rule
rules.body: Status pills are outlined in their status colour on a transparent ground, never filled.

rules.name: The Light Pill Rule
rules.body: A chosen option (segment, language, final download) is a starlight pill with night text. Mint fills mean on, done or in progress (the primary action, progress bars, slider fill, the switch when on, the active tab's count), never chosen-among-options.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every size, percentage, count and dimension uses tabular figures so values do not jitter while files finish.

rules.name: The Glyph Fallback Rule
rules.body: Keep Onest in every Sora stack; the minus (−) and arrow (→) the product prints everywhere come from it.

rules.name: The One Material Rule
rules.body: Glass is the only surface. New panels use the same fill, rim, blur and shadow; no opaque cards. The only tint is mint at 10% (with a 30% mint border where bordered), reserved for the drop zone while dragging and the privacy note.

rules.name: The Aurora Stays Behind Rule
rules.body: Aurora colour exists only in the fixed, blurred background layers. It never becomes a fill, border or gradient on a component.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: An inner shape's radius is its container's radius minus the inset, so 24 → 18 → 16 → 14 → 10 steps down as elements nest.

dos: Do build every new surface from the glass material: glass fill, 1px glass edge, 26px backdrop blur, 24px radius, the Glass shadow.
Do keep polar mint for the one primary action, progress, saving and focus.
Do show selection as a starlight pill with night text.
Do outline status pills in their status colour: mist queued, amber working, mint done, rose failed.
Do use tabular figures for every size, percentage and count, and keep Onest in the font stack for − and →.
Do nest radii by subtracting the inset (24 → 18 → 16 → 14 → 10) and make anything pressable a pill.
Do keep motion soft and short on the soft ease (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)), and collapse it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent or use aurora hues on components; the aurora stays blurred behind the glass.
Don't fill status pills or use amber and rose for anything but working, growth and failure.
Don't use opaque cards, tint panels in any colour but the 10% mint of the drag-over zone and privacy note, or stack extra shadows to create depth.
Don't use sharp corners on buttons, controls or floating panels; only the dock, pinned flush to the window edge, goes square.
Don't go bright or neon: no saturated glows, no high-chroma fills. The palette stays discreet by request.
Don't fall back to a white page with an indigo accent.
